scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The missing code
scenes.caption: Nikhil needs a fictional kit code from the lending ledger. The row is short, but Reva notices a draft search jumps over alternate cards. Unchecked cards could hold the target, so they trace every examined position.
scenes.speech: Nikhil needs a fictional kit code from the lending ledger. The row is short, but Reva notices a draft search jumps over alternate cards. Unchecked cards could hold the target, so they trace every examined position.
scenes.dialogue: Which cards have actually been compared?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A bounded scan
scenes.caption: They start at position zero and inspect each existing item in order. After a failed equality comparison, the position increases by one. The scan stops immediately on a match or before accessing a position outside the list, whichever happens first.
scenes.speech: They start at position zero and inspect each existing item in order. After a failed equality comparison, the position increases by one. The scan stops immediately on a match or before accessing a position outside the list, whichever happens first.
scenes.dialogue: The bound protects the next access.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: What counts as work?
scenes.caption: For this investigation they count only comparisons between an item and the target. Checking a loop bound is necessary but belongs to a different count. State this convention first so learners do not accidentally count different events.
scenes.speech: For this investigation they count only comparisons between an item and the target. Checking a loop bound is necessary but belongs to a different count. State this convention first so learners do not accidentally count different events.
scenes.dialogue: Name the event before counting it.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Can we halve it?
scenes.caption: Nikhil suggests repeatedly discarding half the ledger. That method relies on a known ordering of the searched values. Choose a plan that checks this precondition, rather than assuming code order from a list sorted by arrival time or from tidy handwriting.
scenes.speech: Nikhil suggests repeatedly discarding half the ledger. That method relies on a known ordering of the searched values. Choose a plan that checks this precondition, rather than assuming code order from a list sorted by arrival time or from tidy handwriting.
scenes.dialogue: A method carries assumptions with it.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Found, missing, empty
scenes.caption: They test a target at the end, an absent target and an empty ledger. The last case should examine no items at all. Accessing the first item before checking length fails before any useful comparison.
scenes.speech: They test a target at the end, an absent target and an empty ledger. The last case should examine no items at all. Accessing the first item before checking length fails before any useful comparison.
scenes.dialogue: An empty row still has a defined result.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Keep the evidence
scenes.caption: Their search sheet records examined positions, comparison count and final found status. It also states whether sortedness was guaranteed. Another learner can reproduce the search and spot skipped records without executing a program.
scenes.speech: Their search sheet records examined positions, comparison count and final found status. It also states whether sortedness was guaranteed. Another learner can reproduce the search and spot skipped records without executing a program.
scenes.dialogue: A failed search needs a complete trace too.
